title: Rust: Binary Search Tree
description: Implement a binary search tree with insert, search, and traversal operations.

steps.title: Define Tree Node
steps.description: Define a `TreeNode<T>` struct with value, left, and right children (using `Option<Box<TreeNode<T>>>`). Define a `Tree<T>` struct wrapping an optional root. Create an empty tree.
hints: `struct TreeNode<T> { value: T, left: Option<Box<TreeNode<T>>>, right: Option<Box<TreeNode<T>>> }`

verification.failureMessage: Create and print a description of an empty tree.

steps.title: Insert into BST
steps.description: Implement `insert(&mut self, value: T)` on Tree. For a BST, values less than or equal to the current node go left, greater values go right. Insert [5, 3, 7, 1, 9].
hints: Use a recursive helper or loop through the tree.
Compare value with current node's value.
If going left or right and the child is None, insert there.

verification.failureMessage: Insert 5,3,7,1,9 into the BST and print the values (traversal).

steps.title: In-Order Traversal
steps.description: Implement `in_order(&self) -> Vec<&T>` that performs in-order traversal (left, root, right) and returns the values as a Vec. Print the result.
hints: Recursively traverse left, push root value, traverse right.
In-order traversal of a BST gives sorted order.

verification.failureMessage: Print the in-order traversal of the BST.

steps.title: Search in BST
steps.description: Implement `contains(&self, value: &T) -> bool` that searches for a value. Return true if found. Test with values 7 (found) and 4 (not found).
hints: If less, search left; if greater, search right. If None, return false.

verification.failureMessage: Print whether 7 (true) and 4 (false) exist in the tree.

steps.title: Tree Height
steps.description: Implement `height(&self) -> u32` that returns the height of the tree (number of edges on longest root-to-leaf path). Insert values [5, 3, 7, 1] and print the height.

verification.failureMessage: Print the height of the BST.
